outcome.answer:
No supplied paper specifically describes a “Chenrun Wang research idea benchmark” or a benchmark by that name. However, the results include multiple benchmarks related to research-idea generation and evaluation that could be relevant to the idea of such a benchmark.

LigBench (Chenrun Wang et al.) proposes a unified, human-aligned benchmark for LLM-based research idea generation, along with PAIR-IQ to train pairwise idea-judgment models for more objective comparative evaluation [1]. Other benchmarks focus on narrower aspects: RINoBench evaluates automated novelty judgment of research ideas with human-labeled gold standards and rubric-based novelty scoring/judgments [2], Lit2Test benchmarks falsifiable research ideation using precommitted falsifying outcomes [3], and SoundnessBench benchmarks methodological viability (“soundness”) of research proposals before full review-stage validation [4].
